mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 230.0 signals persistent inflation requiring aggressive rate hikes, depressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 230.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and federal funds rate signal economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising UNRATE and rising FEDFUNDS fails to produce negative returns in more than 45% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.5%), a decline in non-farm payrolls indicates worsening labor market conditions, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5% and PAYEMS declines, or the Rank IC for the signal falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts signals strengthening consumer demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in less than 55% of instances when HOUST rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and industrial production indicate robust economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and rising INDPRO fails to produce positive returns in more than 45% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales falling below 400,000 million dollars signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when RSAFS < 400000.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In low industrial production regimes (INDPRO < 95.0), a decline in industrial production signals supply shocks, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0 and INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC for the signal falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
